payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each point a, iterate over all unordered pairs (b, c) with b != a, c != a, compute vectors ab and ac, check if dot product > 0 (acute angle). If found, a is bad; else good. Early break on detection.
payload.rationale: Code performs complete search over all triples; no recursion or state backtracking, but 'search_backtracking' is the most generic candidate subtype for exhaustive search patterns. No pruning beyond early exit.
